name: dopamine-plan
description: Turns bloated 400-line corporate specs into sharp, high-momentum battle blueprints built for agentic engineering. Bans stale "3-6 months" human-team timelines (estimates in hours, days, and focused sessions), mandates real competitor and best-in-class open-source recon before designing so you never ship dated AI slop, pushes research and frontier projects toward cutting-edge experimental methods instead of safe legacy defaults, enforces 80/20 focus, kills the modern LLM obsession with unasked critic-gates, verification layers, and checkbox test phases, builds flexible zero-hardcode / zero-regex architectures, and ships vertical full-strength milestones on one clean screen. Triggers: "dopamine-plan", "dopamine plan", "plan this", "architecture plan", "implementation plan", "design the architecture".
